definitions.explanation: Showing how something works or is done by actually performing it in front of an audience, especially for products, cooking, or crafts.
Performing something live on stage or in person, as opposed to recorded or rehearsed versions.

examples.japanese: {実演|じつえん}{販売|はんばい}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: To conduct a live sales demonstration.

examples.japanese: シェフが{料理|りょうり}の{作|つく}り{方|かた}を{実演|じつえん}した。
examples.english: The chef demonstrated how to make the dish.

examples.japanese: デパートの{地下|ちか}で{和菓子|わがし}の{実演|じつえん}{販売|はんばい}をしていたので、つい{買|か}ってしまった。
examples.english: They were doing a live demonstration sale of Japanese sweets in the department store basement, so I ended up buying some.

examples.japanese: {舞台|ぶたい}で{実演|じつえん}する。
{映像|えいぞう}ではなく{実演|じつえん}で{見|み}たい。
examples.english: I want to see it performed live, not on video.

examples.japanese: {伝統|でんとう}{芸能|げいのう}の{実演|じつえん}を{間近|まぢか}で{見|み}ることができた。
examples.english: I was able to see a traditional performing art demonstrated up close.

notes:
The compound {実演|じつえん}{販売|はんばい} (live demonstration sale) is extremely common in Japanese retail, especially in department stores and food halls, where vendors prepare food or demonstrate products in front of customers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実演|じつえん}{販売|はんばい} — live demonstration sale
- {実演|じつえん}コーナー — demonstration area/booth
- {実演|じつえん}を{見|み}る — to watch a demonstration
- {実演|じつえん}する — to demonstrate, to perform live

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デモンストレーション — demonstration (loanword, often shortened to デモ)
- {公演|こうえん} — public performance (larger-scale, theatrical)
- {上演|じょうえん} — staging, performance (of a play or show)
